disclaimer: General legal information, not legal advice. Coverage, notice, causation and agency findings change what applies.

citations.excerpt: Visible mold growth, as determined by a health officer or a code enforcement officer
until the lessor has notice of the dilapidation or if the tenant is in violation of Section 1941.2.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Dampness that endangers occupants can make a unit substandard. Mold only counts as substandard once a health or code enforcement officer determines it. The landlord's mold repair duty starts when they have notice.
tenant_options: Give the landlord written notice and keep proof of when and how
Request an Oakland code enforcement inspection
Talk to free legal aid before using any rent remedy
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No fixed repair deadline in these sections.
cautions: A photo or AI label is never an officer's determination
Minor mold on surfaces meant to get wet (like a shower) is excluded
Do not presume the tenant caused it

citations.excerpt: Effective waterproofing and weather protection of roof and exterior walls, including unbroken windows and doors.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Keep the roof, walls, windows and doors weatherproof and keep plumbing in good working order.
tenant_options: Document source and location of the leak
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No universal repair deadline. Civil Code 1942 uses a 'reasonable time' (see general_rules).

citations.excerpt: kept in every part clean, sanitary, and free from all accumulations of debris, filth, rubbish, garbage, rodents, and vermin.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Building and grounds clean and free of rodents and vermin at move-in and in areas the landlord controls. Infestations count as substandard when an authorized officer determines it.
tenant_options: Request an inspection or vector control referral
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No fixed repair deadline in these sections.
cautions: Tenant upkeep duties and causation matter

citations.excerpt: Electrical lighting, with wiring and electrical equipment that conformed with applicable law at the time of installation, maintained in good working order.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Keep wiring and electrical equipment in good working order. Older wiring is only acceptable if it is currently safe.
tenant_options: Safety first (the health agent's urgent message)
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No fixed repair period. Never present the 30-day presumption as a safe waiting period for dangerous wiring.
cautions: Civil Code 1941.3 is about locks and windows, not wiring. Do not cite it here

citations.excerpt: is deemed to be in violation of this part as to any portion that contains lead hazards.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Avoid lead hazards such as deteriorated lead paint, contaminated dust or soil, or disturbing lead paint without containment.
tenant_options: Request a lead assessment or inspection
cautions: Peeling paint alone does not prove lead
Regulatory thresholds (Title 17) not verified. Do not hardcode numbers

citations.excerpt: Heating facilities that conformed with applicable law at the time of installation, maintained in good working order.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Provide heating that works and keep it in good working order.
tenant_options: File an Oakland 'No heat' complaint (OAK311 or online)
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No numeric temperature or repair deadline verified.
cautions: Minimum indoor temperature not verified. Do not state a number

citations.excerpt: The carbon monoxide device shall be operable at the time that the tenant takes possession.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Install and maintain required CO alarms. The tenant reports a missing or broken alarm, and the landlord must fix reported problems.
tenant_options: Emergency first if CO is suspected (health agent urgent path)
Report a missing or broken alarm to the landlord in writing
hazard_laws.deadline_note: The 30-day notice-to-correct in 17926(c) is about fines, never a reason to wait on suspected CO.
cautions: A missing alarm is a compliance issue. It is not evidence of CO exposure

citations.excerpt: Plumbing or gas facilities that conformed to applicable law in effect at the time of installation, maintained in good working order.

hazard_laws.landlord_duty: Keep gas facilities in good, safe working order.
tenant_options: Emergency first: leave and call PG&E or 911 (health agent urgent path)
Afterward: written notice, inspection, legal aid
hazard_laws.deadline_note: No gas-specific repair deadline verified. Never put an active leak on a repair timer.

general_rules.summary: General duty to repair conditions that make a unit untenantable.

Repair-and-deduct or move out, only after notice and landlord neglect. Capped at one month's rent, no more than twice in 12 months. 30 days after notice is presumed reasonable, but it is not a universal deadline.

Limits on collecting rent only when an official inspection found the problem, an officer gave written notice, and it stayed unfixed 35 days after that official notice. The 35 days run from the officer's notice, not the tenant's letter.
Protection against retaliation for up to 180 days after a repair request, complaint or inspection, with conditions. Not blanket protection from eviction.

city_procedures.name: Oakland property complaint (code enforcement)
city_procedures.how: OAK311 app or online form, with address, description and optional photos. Covers no heat, electrical, plumbing.

city_procedures.name: Courtesy Notice path
city_procedures.how: For small first-reported problems the city can send a Courtesy Notice without an inspection. The owner has 21 days to return a certification form with photos. An inspector-confirmed violation becomes a Notice of Violation.

city_procedures.name: Rent Adjustment Program decreased-services petition
city_procedures.how: Tenants in covered units can petition for a rent reduction. Generally 90 days, but ongoing conditions (like a leaking roof) can be filed any time. Coverage varies; many units are excluded.

city_procedures.name: Tenant Protection Ordinance (OMC 8.22.640)
city_procedures.how: Lists failing to make repairs among possible bad-faith harassment. Ordinary disrepair is not automatically harassment.

legal_aid.name: Centro Legal de la Raza
legal_aid.eligibility: Free tenant legal services per the City of Oakland referral page. Confirm eligibility at intake.

legal_aid.name: East Bay Community Law Center
legal_aid.eligibility: Counseling and paperwork help for low-income tenants; free workshops. Confirm at intake.

legal_aid.name: Bay Area Legal Aid
legal_aid.eligibility: Help for low-income people with unsafe housing, evictions, lockouts, utility shutoffs. Confirm at intake.
